CARD RGI predictions for resistance gene content

Source: R/rgi_results.R
rgi_results.Rd

A data frame containing AMR gene predictions and associated metadata derived from CARD-RGI annotations. Each row corresponds to a sample's phenotype and its predicted gene-level features based on known resistance determinants.

Usage

rgi_results

Format

A data frame with N rows and 15 columns:

genus

Genus name after cleaning

species

Species name after cleaning

accession

SRA identifier for each sample

phenotype

Interpretive label: Resistant, Susceptible, or ?

antibiotic

Name of the antibiotic tested

measurement_value

Processed MIC or inhibition zone value

categoria_recodificada

Recoded phenotype category used in classification or binning

aroXXXXXXX_*

Binary or numeric indicator for gene variant presence; includes SNP-level and family-level predictions from CARD-RGI

Source

Resistance gene calls generated via CARD-RGI pipeline vX.X on CAMDA 2025 challenge accessions

Details

Columns prefixed with aro represent individual AMR gene families or variants predicted using CARD-RGI. These may include point mutations (e.g., SNPs), protein homologs, or ontology-linked resistance mechanisms. The column names follow the ARO ontology identifiers from CARD and are suitable for downstream modeling.
